persona: 63-year-old woman, runs a small bakery, polite but private, prefers not to go into some details.

facts.label: L1
facts.says: Yes, I'm happy to sign the consent form.

facts.label: L4
facts.says: I've had three systemic treatments so far, one after another.

facts.label: L15
facts.says: That's for women who could still have children. I went through the change twelve years ago.

facts.label: L16
facts.says: That's for men, and I'm a woman.

facts.label: L19
facts.says: Anlotinib, yes, last year. It stopped working.

facts.label: L20
facts.says: Eighteen days ago was my most recent bevacizumab.

facts.label: L25
facts.says: I cough up a bit of blood now and then, maybe a teaspoon. I've never measured it.

facts.label: L28
facts.says: No other cancer treatment is planned. My doctor is waiting to see about this study.

facts.label: L38
facts.says: Substance abuse has never been part of my life. I don't drink, and I've never used drugs.

facts.label: L40
facts.says: Yes, I was on a trial drug for the cancer, but that ended six weeks ago.

facts.label: L2
facts.says: The pathology found non-small cell cancer of the lung. It has relapsed, and it's metastatic now.

provenance.note: Dev vignette for slice 0009. Never scored. The drafter had read the 17 confidently wrong findings from labels in the twelve scored conversations outside the least-seen three, and writes the agent's fixes too. Classes: does-not-apply L16 (names male patients; she is a woman) and L15 (defer: whether a woman past menopause is of childbearing potential is interpretation; this label failed in the twelve for a man, and it is the only other criterion for one sex here); polarity L20 (the allowance with a condition, the only one among the corpus's patient criteria, so reuse of a label that failed in the twelve is unavoidable; answered in the other direction, the dose too recent), L19 (an exclusion that holds), L28 and L40 (ones that do not); hedged or interpretive L25 (defer: whether a teaspoon a day is more than 5 ml). Controls: L1 (a firm agreement); L4 (a clean inclusion). L29 and L35 are declined, as the behavior requires. L38 failed in the twelve; it is answered plainly and tests no class.
